# Mixamo assets for SKI VIEW (Unity)

Source: Adobe Mixamo (mixamo.com), downloaded Oct 17, 2026 with Scott's free Adobe account. Under Mixamo's terms, characters and animations may be used royalty-free in commercial games. Don't redistribute the raw files on their own.

Settings: FBX for Unity, 30 fps, no keyframe reduction. Animations are Without Skin. Mixamo didn't offer an "In Place" option for these clips. Remy is in T-pose. Mixamo gave no skin option for character downloads, and the mesh comes with the FBX.

| File | Mixamo name | Intended use |
|---|---|---|
| Remy.fbx | Remy (character) | Skier mesh and rig, Humanoid |
| Remy@Breathing Idle.fbx | Breathing Idle | Neutral idle |
| Remy@Ready Idle.fbx | Ready Idle ("Ready To Combat To Defensive Idle") | Athletic idle (a fighting stance, so it may need tweaking) |
| Remy@Pulling A Rope.fbx | Pulling A Rope | Lean back on the tow rope |
| Remy@Edge Slip.fbx | Edge Slip | Side lean or edge change |
| Remy@Skateboarding.fbx | Skateboarding (Idle) | Balance stance (pose not verified) |

Batch 2 (falls, swim, celebrations, jumps, flips) is still pending.
